yusra.headline: CASE STUDY — YUSRA HEALTH
yusra.subheadline: Transforming healthcare delivery in Yemen through AI-powered clinical decision support and integrated hospital management.

problem.title: PROBLEM
items: Fragmented paper-based records across 12 hospitals
Average diagnosis time: 45 minutes per patient
No interoperability — 60% duplicate tests
Critical specialist shortage in rural facilities
Zero real-time visibility into bed capacity or drug inventory

solution.title: SOLUTION
items: Multi-agent clinical decision support (CDS) reducing diagnosis to 2.3 seconds
FHIR R4 compliant unified patient record across all facilities
Predictive bed management and drug inventory optimization
Telemedicine bridge connecting rural clinics to specialists in Sana'a
Offline-first PWA for areas with intermittent connectivity

architecture.title: ARCHITECTURE
items: Event-driven microservices (.NET 8, Azure Kubernetes Service)
Agent orchestration layer: 12 specialized clinical agents
Event sourcing + CQRS for audit trail and replay
PostgreSQL + Redis + Azure Cosmos DB (multi-model)
SignalR for real-time clinical collaboration

implementation.title: IMPLEMENTATION
items: 6-month phased rollout across 12 hospitals
Zero-downtime migration from legacy MUMPS systems
Clinician training program: 400+ staff certified
HIPAA/GDPR compliance with Yemen data sovereignty
Chaos engineering: monthly game days, 99.99% resilience

outcome.title: OUTCOME
items: Diagnosis latency: 45min → 2.3sec (99.9% improvement)
Duplicate tests eliminated: 60% → <2%
Patient throughput: +340% without new hires
Specialist access: 100% rural coverage via telemedicine
Cost per encounter: -42% operational savings

method.headline: THE ABDULGHANI METHOD
method.subheadline: A systematic approach to building autonomous systems that scale. Seven phases. Zero compromise.

steps.title: PROBLEM
steps.description: Define the true constraint. Not symptoms — the fundamental bottleneck. Measure it. Write it down. Get consensus.

steps.title: UNDERSTAND
steps.description: Map the system boundary. Identify every actor, data flow, and failure mode. Build the mental model before writing code.

steps.title: ARCHITECT
steps.description: Choose the right abstraction. State machine? Actor? Event log? Pipeline? The architecture must match the problem topology.

steps.title: BUILD
steps.description: Write the thinnest slice that proves the architecture. Observability first. Tests as documentation. No premature optimization.

steps.title: VERIFY
steps.description: Chaos test it. Load test it. Formal verify critical paths. If it hasn't failed in staging, it's not ready for production.

steps.title: DEPLOY
steps.description: Blue-green. Canary. Feature flags. Rollback in <30 seconds. Zero-downtime is not optional — it's the baseline.

steps.title: EVOLVE
steps.description: Measure everything. Learn from production. Refactor ruthlessly. The system that doesn't evolve becomes legacy.
